events.content: STRATEGY: PROPOSE - need a practical fix so I can keep cooking and stop being blamed. Observations: smell spread into bedrooms again; Jamie, Casey and Robin all complained and it landed on me. I work from home and cook most nights as a break; I also buy most shared items. Being called out in front of everyone bothers me more than the pan or the smell. Options: apologise and stop cooking (not what I want), argue (won't solve it), or propose clear simple rules plus an immediate clean-up. Plan: say why I cook, state what I buy, propose two simple house rules (cooks wash their own pans same night; always use extractor/open window), propose shared fund/rota for supplies, and ask for the pan to be cleaned now or someone volunteers. Keep tone direct.

Look — I cook most nights because I work from home and it's my break, and I also buy most of the shared stuff. I don't mind cooking, but I won't be the default culprit. Proposal: whoever cooks washes their pans that night, and we always run the extractor/open a window while cooking. Also let's set a small shared fund or a rota for dish soap/gas. For tonight, can whoever left the pan please wash it now? If nobody does, I'll wash it this time, but I want us to agree the rules so this doesn't keep happening.
Waiting for their responses.
